zh:
> 本文根据 [Cataclysm: Dark Days Ahead 项目 README](https://github.com/CleverRaven/Cataclysm-DDA/blob/57cf429e845fec8ae0405ec0f4dca5921c9c6d79/README.md) 翻译并修改相对链接；原文由项目贡献者创作，译文采用 [CC BY-SA 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/) 许可。 # Cataclysm: Dark Days Ahead Cataclysm: Dark Days Ahead 是一款以后末日世界为背景的回合制生存游戏。虽然有人称它为“僵尸游戏”，但 Cataclysm 的内容远不止于此。在严酷、持续存在且程序生成的世界中挣扎求生。从已经消亡的文明遗迹中搜寻食物、装备，或是幸运的话找到一辆油箱加满的车，赶紧逃离险境。与各种强大的怪物战斗或逃脱：从僵尸、巨型昆虫到杀人机器人，还有更加奇异致命的东西，以及和你一样觊觎你所拥有物品的其他人……

## 下载 **发布版本** - [稳定版](https://cataclysmdda.org/releases/) | [实验版](https://cataclysmdda.org/experimental/) **源代码** - 可以下载 [.zip 压缩包](https://github.com/CleverRaven/Cataclysm-DDA/archive/master.zip)，也可以克隆我们的 [GitHub 仓库](https://github.com/CleverRaven/Cataclysm-DDA/)。 [![General build matrix](https://github.com/CleverRaven/Cataclysm-DDA/actions/workflows/matrix.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/CleverRaven/Cataclysm-DDA/actions/workflows/matrix.yml) [![Coverage Status](https://coveralls.io/repos/github/CleverRaven/Cataclysm-DDA/badge.svg?branch=master)](https://coveralls.io/github/CleverRaven/Cataclysm-DDA?branch=master) [![Open Source Helpers](https://www.codetriage.com/cleverraven/cataclysm-dda/badges/users.svg)](https://www.codetriage.com/cleverraven/cataclysm-dda) [![Commit Activity](https://img.shields.io/github/commit-activity/m/CleverRaven/Cataclysm-DDA)](https://github.com/CleverRaven/Cataclysm-DDA/graphs/contributors) [![TODOs](https://badgen.net/https/api.tickgit.com/badgen/github.com/CleverRaven/Cataclysm-DDA)](https://www.tickgit.com/browse?repo=github.com/CleverRaven/Cataclysm-DDA) ### 打包状态 #### Arch Linux Ncurses 版和图块版可从[社区仓库](https://www.archlinux.org/packages/?q=cataclysm-dda)获取。 ```sh sudo pacman -S cataclysm-dda sudo pacman -S cataclysm-dda-tiles ``` #### Fedora Ncurses 版和图块版可从[官方仓库](https://src.fedoraproject.org/rpms/cataclysm-dda)获取。 ```sh sudo dnf install cataclysm-dda ``` #### Debian / Ubuntu Ncurses 版和图块版可从[官方仓库](https://tracker.debian.org/pkg/cataclysm-dda)获取。 ```sh sudo apt install cataclysm-dda-curses cataclysm-dda-sdl ``` #### Flatpak 从 [Flathub](https://flathub.org/apps/org.cataclysmdda.CataclysmDDA) 下载。 ## 编译 请阅读 [COMPILING.md](https://github.com/CleverRaven/Cataclysm-DDA/blob/57cf429e845fec8ae0405ec0f4dca5921c9c6d79/doc/c++/COMPILING.md)：其中涵盖一般信息，以及 Linux、OS X、Windows 和 BSD 更具体的构建方法。请参阅 [COMPILER_SUPPORT.md](https://github.com/CleverRaven/Cataclysm-DDA/blob/57cf429e845fec8ae0405ec0f4dca5921c9c6d79/doc/c++/COMPILER_SUPPORT.md)了解支持的编译器。你也可以随时在 [doc/](https://github.com/CleverRaven/Cataclysm-DDA/tree/57cf429e845fec8ae0405ec0f4dca5921c9c6d79/doc) 中查找更多信息。 我们还提供以下构建指南： * 使用 `MSYS2` 在 Windows 上构建：[COMPILING-MSYS.md](https://github.com/CleverRaven/Cataclysm-DDA/blob/57cf429e845fec8ae0405ec0f4dca5921c9c6d79/doc/c++/COMPILING-MSYS.md) * 使用 `vcpkg` 在 Windows 上构建：[COMPILING-VS-VCPKG.md](https://github.com/CleverRaven/Cataclysm-DDA/blob/57cf429e845fec8ae0405ec0f4dca5921c9c6d79/doc/c++/COMPILING-VS-VCPKG.md) * 使用 `cmake` 构建：[COMPILING-CMAKE.md](https://github.com/CleverRaven/Cataclysm-DDA/blob/57cf429e845fec8ae0405ec0f4dca5921c9c6d79/doc/c++/COMPILING-CMAKE.md)（*非官方指南*） ## 参与贡献 Cataclysm: Dark Days Ahead 是超过 1000 名志愿者根据知识共享署名-相同方式共享 3.0 许可证贡献的成果。游戏代码和内容可为任何目的自由使用、修改和重新分发。详情见 https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/。 项目附带的部分代码不属于本项目，采用不同的软件许可证发布；这些文件各自带有许可声明。 详情请参阅 [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/CleverRaven/Cataclysm-DDA/blob/57cf429e845fec8ae0405ec0f4dca5921c9c6d79/CONTRIBUTING.md)。 特别感谢贡献者，包括但不限于以下人员： Made with [contrib.rocks](https://contrib.rocks). ## 社区 论坛： https://discourse.cataclysmdda.org GitHub 仓库： https://github.com/CleverRaven/Cataclysm-DDA IRC： [Libera Chat](https://libera.chat) 上的 `#CataclysmDDA`，https://web.libera.chat/#CataclysmDDA 官方 Discord： https://discord.gg/jFEc7Yp ## 常见问题 #### 有教程吗？ 有，你可以在主菜单的 **Special** 菜单中找到教程（请注意，由于代码发生大量变化，教程可能无法运行）。也可以在游戏中通过 `?` 键访问文档。 #### 如何修改按键绑定？ 按 `?` 键，然后按 `1` 查看完整按键命令列表。按 `+` 添加按键绑定，用对应的字母键 `a-w` 选择动作，再按希望分配给该动作的键。 #### 如何开始一个新世界？ 主菜单中的 **World** 会为你生成一个新世界。选择 **Create World**。 #### 我发现了错误，该怎么办？ 请在[我们的 GitHub 页面](https://github.com/CleverRaven/Cataclysm-DDA/issues/)使用[错误报告模板](https://github.com/CleverRaven/Cataclysm-DDA/issues/new?template=bug_report.yaml)提交 issue。如果无法提交，请发送电子邮件至 `kevin.granade@gmail.com`。 #### 我想提出建议，该怎么办？ 请在[我们的 GitHub 页面](https://github.com/CleverRaven/Cataclysm-DDA/issues/)使用[功能请求模板](https://github.com/CleverRaven/Cataclysm-DDA/issues/new?template=feature_request.yaml)提交 issue。
en:
# Cataclysm: Dark Days Ahead Cataclysm: Dark Days Ahead is a turn-based survival game set in a post-apocalyptic world. While some have described it as a "zombie game", there is far more to Cataclysm than that. Struggle to survive in a harsh, persistent, procedurally generated world. Scavenge the remnants of a dead civilization for food, equipment, or, if you are lucky, a vehicle with a full tank of gas to get you the hell out of Dodge. Fight to defeat or escape from a wide variety of powerful monstrosities, from zombies to giant insects to killer robots and things far stranger and deadlier, and against the others like yourself, who want what you have...

## Downloads **Releases** - [Stable](https://cataclysmdda.org/releases/) | [Experimental](https://cataclysmdda.org/experimental/) **Source** - The source can be downloaded as a [.zip archive](https://github.com/CleverRaven/Cataclysm-DDA/archive/master.zip), or cloned from our [GitHub repo](https://github.com/CleverRaven/Cataclysm-DDA/). [![General build matrix](https://github.com/CleverRaven/Cataclysm-DDA/actions/workflows/matrix.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/CleverRaven/Cataclysm-DDA/actions/workflows/matrix.yml) [![Coverage Status](https://coveralls.io/repos/github/CleverRaven/Cataclysm-DDA/badge.svg?branch=master)](https://coveralls.io/github/CleverRaven/Cataclysm-DDA?branch=master) [![Open Source Helpers](https://www.codetriage.com/cleverraven/cataclysm-dda/badges/users.svg)](https://www.codetriage.com/cleverraven/cataclysm-dda) [![Commit Activity](https://img.shields.io/github/commit-activity/m/CleverRaven/Cataclysm-DDA)](https://github.com/CleverRaven/Cataclysm-DDA/graphs/contributors) [![TODOs](https://badgen.net/https/api.tickgit.com/badgen/github.com/CleverRaven/Cataclysm-DDA)](https://www.tickgit.com/browse?repo=github.com/CleverRaven/Cataclysm-DDA) ### Packaging status #### Arch Linux Ncurses and tiles versions are available in the [community repos](https://www.archlinux.org/packages/?q=cataclysm-dda). ```sh sudo pacman -S cataclysm-dda sudo pacman -S cataclysm-dda-tiles ``` #### Fedora Ncurses and tiles versions are available in the [official repos](https://src.fedoraproject.org/rpms/cataclysm-dda). ```sh sudo dnf install cataclysm-dda ``` #### Debian / Ubuntu Ncurses and tiles versions are available in the [official repos](https://tracker.debian.org/pkg/cataclysm-dda). ```sh sudo apt install cataclysm-dda-curses cataclysm-dda-sdl ``` #### Flatpak Download from [Flathub](https://flathub.org/apps/org.cataclysmdda.CataclysmDDA). ## Compile Please read [COMPILING.md](https://github.com/CleverRaven/Cataclysm-DDA/blob/57cf429e845fec8ae0405ec0f4dca5921c9c6d79/doc/c++/COMPILING.md) - it covers general information and more specific recipes for Linux, OS X, Windows and BSD. See [COMPILER_SUPPORT.md](https://github.com/CleverRaven/Cataclysm-DDA/blob/57cf429e845fec8ae0405ec0f4dca5921c9c6d79/doc/c++/COMPILER_SUPPORT.md) for details on which compilers we support. And you can always dig for more information in [doc/](https://github.com/CleverRaven/Cataclysm-DDA/tree/57cf429e845fec8ae0405ec0f4dca5921c9c6d79/doc). We also have the following build guides: * Building on Windows with `MSYS2` at [COMPILING-MSYS.md](https://github.com/CleverRaven/Cataclysm-DDA/blob/57cf429e845fec8ae0405ec0f4dca5921c9c6d79/doc/c++/COMPILING-MSYS.md) * Building on Windows with `vcpkg` at [COMPILING-VS-VCPKG.md](https://github.com/CleverRaven/Cataclysm-DDA/blob/57cf429e845fec8ae0405ec0f4dca5921c9c6d79/doc/c++/COMPILING-VS-VCPKG.md) * Building with `cmake` at [COMPILING-CMAKE.md](https://github.com/CleverRaven/Cataclysm-DDA/blob/57cf429e845fec8ae0405ec0f4dca5921c9c6d79/doc/c++/COMPILING-CMAKE.md) (*unofficial guide*) ## Contribute Cataclysm: Dark Days Ahead is the result of contributions from over 1000 volunteers under the Creative Commons Attribution ShareAlike 3.0 license. The code and content of the game is free to use, modify, and redistribute for any purpose whatsoever. See https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/ for details. Some code distributed with the project is not part of the project and is released under different software licenses; the files covered by different software licenses have their own license notices. Please see [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/CleverRaven/Cataclysm-DDA/blob/57cf429e845fec8ae0405ec0f4dca5921c9c6d79/CONTRIBUTING.md) for details. Special thanks to the contributors, including but not limited to, people below: Made with [contrib.rocks](https://contrib.rocks). ## Community Forums: https://discourse.cataclysmdda.org GitHub repo: https://github.com/CleverRaven/Cataclysm-DDA IRC: `#CataclysmDDA` on [Libera Chat](https://libera.chat), https://web.libera.chat/#CataclysmDDA Official Discord: https://discord.gg/jFEc7Yp ## Frequently Asked Questions #### Is there a tutorial? Yes, you can find the tutorial in the **Special** menu at the main menu (be aware that due to many code changes the tutorial may not function). You can also access documentation in-game via the `?` key. #### How can I change the key bindings? Press the `?` key, followed by the `1` key to see the full list of key commands. Press the `+` key to add a key binding, select which action with the corresponding letter key `a-w`, and then the key you wish to assign to that action. #### How can I start a new world? **World** on the main menu will generate a fresh world for you. Select **Create World**. #### I've found a bug. What should I do? Please submit an issue on [our GitHub page](https://github.com/CleverRaven/Cataclysm-DDA/issues/) using [bug report template](https://github.com/CleverRaven/Cataclysm-DDA/issues/new?template=bug_report.yaml). If you're not able to, send an email to `kevin.granade@gmail.com`. #### I would like to make a suggestion. What should I do? Please submit an issue on [our GitHub page](https://github.com/CleverRaven/Cataclysm-DDA/issues/) using [feature request template](https://github.com/CleverRaven/Cataclysm-DDA/issues/new?template=feature_request.yaml).
